architecture.text: Recent work addresses long-context attention limits, vector-quantization stability, and agentic code generation using techniques like gated linear attention, hyperbolic residual quantization, and two-level KV sharing.

new-models.text: Frontier releases like Xiaomi MiMo-V2.6-Pro 1T-A42B and advanced vision-language agents such as MintAct and OmniVChat dominate, driving efficient open-weights training, native audio-visual dialogue, and multimodal integration.

inference-methods.text: Practitioners are deploying on-policy distillation, disaggregated quantization, and just-in-time state management to push sub-3-bit reasoning, long-context retrieval, and 200K-token laptop serving.

inference-engines.text: Practitioners are deploying techniques like HBM flash tiering, vLLM prefix cache warming, NVIDIA Topograph scheduling, and Flux optical circuit switches to optimize agentic LLM serving and training.

silicon.text: Engineers are optimizing TPU v6e and low-cost FPGA architectures, mitigating GPU cluster power surges, and scaling AI clusters using DRAM/SSD offloading, HBM profiling, and advanced optical interconnects.

training.text: Reinforcement learning updates like PACT, RULER, and group relative policy optimization increasingly target reward alignment and hacking across language, video, and code generation agents.

economics.text: Inference costs are collapsing industry-wide by 40 to 50 percent, driving a transition toward self-hosted open-weight models and the economic reality of tokens too cheap to meter.
